" ) def render_user_profile(username: str, bio: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. bio : str A user-provided biography that may contain multiple sentences. status_message : str A short, current status message. Returns ------- str The HTML string ready to be sent to the client, with all user input escaped. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, bio, status_message)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be strings.") # Escape user input to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status )
